When a user connects MetaMask to your dapp, the browser hands you their wallet address through window.ethereum.request({ method: "eth_requestAccounts" }). entry.summary: New: One stream. Now it goes everywhere you need it. Dev, staging, and prod. Real-time processing and long-term storage. No duplicate pipelines, no config drift, and no extra cost.
